Title: How to build a YouTube brain in one afternoon
Body:

Title: My scheduler bug took down 60 agents for 3 days
Body:
My scheduler bug took down 60 agents for 3 days.

Root cause: hardcoded path that broke after a folder move.

Lesson: Never hardcode paths in automation systems.

Now everything uses relative paths + environment variables.

Failures teach faster than tutorials.
